method: Codex read two fictional evidence packets during development using docs/email-reading-prompt.md. The reader received the shortlisted bill lines and emails with no scenario labels, expected outcomes or tests. The public page replays these saved interpretations.

quotes.text: We can bring the crew back after closing on Thursday for $400 ex GST.
I approve $400 ex GST for the crew to come back after closing on Thursday at Banksia Rooms. Please book it.

items.reason: Jo explicitly approved $400 ex GST for the crew's Thursday return after closing and asked Sam to book it.

quotes.text: Could you price collection of the old fittings at Banksia Rooms? Please send the figure before booking.
Collection would be $200 ex GST. I'll wait for your confirmation.

items.reason: Jo asked for the price of collecting the old fittings. Sam quoted $200 ex GST and said he would wait for confirmation.
items.draft_question: Jo, did you approve the $200 ex GST quote for collecting the old fittings?

quotes.text: We can come back after closing on Thursday for $400 ex GST, or bring an extra installer during normal hours on Friday for $400 ex GST.

items.reason: Sam offered two ways to finish for the same price. Jo said to go ahead without choosing between Thursday after closing and Friday during normal hours.
items.draft_question: Jo, which $400 ex GST option did you mean to book for Banksia Rooms, Thursday after closing or the extra installer on Friday?

quotes.text: Could you price collection of the old fittings at Banksia Rooms? Please send the figure before booking.
Collection would be $200 ex GST. I'll wait for your confirmation.

items.reason: Jo requested a price before booking collection of the old fittings. Sam quoted $200 ex GST and was waiting for Jo to confirm.
items.draft_question: Jo, did you approve collection of the old fittings at $200 ex GST after receiving Sam's quote?
